items.quote: Den Betrag überweisen Sie bitte binnen 30 Tagen ab dem oben genannten Rechnungsdatum; als Verwendungszweck genügt die Rechnungsnummer.
items.computation: This is a private (civil-law) invoice, not an administrative act, so the period runs under §§ 187, 193 BGB. The triggering event is the Rechnungsdatum itself (23.05.2025); under § 187(1) BGB the day of the event is not counted, so the 30-day period starts on 24.05.2025. Counting 30 days from 24.05.2025: May has 8 remaining days (24-31), leaving 22 days to reach June; 24+22=22.06.2025 is day 30. 22.06.2025 is a Sunday. Under § 193 BGB, if the last day of a period for a payment falls on a Sunday, Saturday or public holiday, the period ends on the next working day. 23.06.2025 is a Monday and not a public holiday in NRW (Fronleichnam, 19.06.2025, already past), so the due date shifts to 23.06.2025.
